block.projecthero.vault_barrier.hint: The Vault's energy walls. Blue fields run on the cell-block power: they front the Maximum Security pods and bar the way down from the Warden's Control Room, and all of them drop when the Control Room breaker is thrown. The red field is the Riot Captain's lockdown on the door out of the Maximum Security hall: it drops when he dies. Nothing breaks them.
block.projecthero.vault_barrier.power: A security field on the cell-block power. Shut the power down at the breaker in the Warden's Control Room.
block.projecthero.vault_barrier.captain: The Riot Captain's lockdown field. It drops when he does.
block.projecthero.vault_breaker.hint: In The Vault's Warden's Control Room. Right-click to cut the cell-block power for good: every blue security field nearby drops (the way down to the Warden's Level opens, and so do the Maximum Security pods), and the Maximum Security wing's Alarm Panels, cameras and lasers go dark.
block.projecthero.vault_breaker.off: The cell-block power is already down.
block.projecthero.site_ward.hint: The old-world sites' alarm sensor (graveyards, temples, the ice hut). A tripwire hangs on it across a doorway: touch the string and it raises the site's alarm, unless the Alarm Panel it is wired to has been sabotaged. Shears cut the string quietly.
projecthero.vault.power_down: Cell-block power down! The security fields drop - and so do the Maximum Security pods.
projecthero.vault.captain_down: The Riot Captain is down. His lockdown field drops: the Control Room is open.
projecthero.vault.riot_captain.rally: The Riot Captain calls his squad!
projecthero.vault.kross.phase2: Kross reaches for the gas canisters - phase 2!
projecthero.guide.hideouts.vault.body: The Vault is a super-prison sunk deep under the overworld - the rarest and most dangerous place in the world, a 10-15 minute crawl. On the surface only a fenced guard post shows; a ladder shaft inside it drops to five floors. A Dungeon Locator (25% from hideout mini-bosses, often in Hideout Vaults) points to the nearest one.
The Cell Block: a two-tier hall of barred cells round a glass guard tower. Most cell doors are broken - escaped inmates roam the hall and the galleries, riot wardens hold the floor. The Security Floor: a checkpoint corridor crossed by two laser tripwires (jump the low one, crouch under the high one), a turret hall under four ceiling turrets (mine them), the security office, and the lockdown gate. Use the console in the office to open the gate. The guard Captain in the office carries the keycard for the Blast Door behind the gate. Riot wardens carry shields: hit them from the side or behind.
Behind the keycard Blast Door: a laser corridor (beams at knee and head height from both walls, cameras at each end), then the laser grid - three rows of floor beams, each with one gap (look for the green floor block), swept by two cameras. Then the hall: eight pods of maximum-security inmates behind blue security fields, snipers on the catwalks over them, and the Riot Captain with his squad.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.vault.control: The Riot Captain and the Control Room

The Riot Captain (380 health, a tower shield that cuts frontal hits): Shield Rush (a short charge, 9 damage and a shove; into a wall he is dazed), Flashbang (blinds everyone with a clear line to it for 3 s - break line of sight) and, once at half health, Rally (two shield-bearers arrive and his men hit harder). His death drops the red field on the hall's far door. In the Warden's Control Room, throw the cell-block breaker: the blue field on the way down drops - but so do the pods' fields, and the inmates come out fighting. The power cut also kills the Maximum Security wing's cameras and lasers.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.vault.lockdow: At half health he is enraged: faster, harder-hitting, shorter cooldowns, and Lockdown - sirens, blast shutters slam over the arena's doorways (over the hazard-striped track) and riot wardens and a gunner drop in. A Lockdown lasts 30 s and returns every 45 s. Nobody gets in or out until it lifts.
Enraged, Kross adds two moves. Riot Gas Volley: he lobs three canisters at you and either side of you; each leaves a choking cloud for 8 s (2 damage a half-second, blinded and slowed) - get out of the green smoke. Breach Slam: he crouches, leaps onto the spot where you stood and lands in a shockwave (up to 16 damage within 6 blocks, thrown and slowed) - keep moving when he crouches.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.vault.alarm.b: The whole Vault is one alarm zone with an Alarm Panel on every floor, cameras, lasers, alarm lamps and reinforcement points. Guards have roles: alarm runners (one on every floor), medics, shield-bearers, snipers on the galleries and catwalks, and the Captain with the keycard. Reach the Dungeon Vaults without the alarm ever going off for the Ghost bonus.
projecthero.guide.loot.tier2: Tier 2 Sites: the 19 old labs, craters, temples and crash sites, each with a guarded annex (a Captain with the vault room's keycard, an Alarm Panel and a runner) and a Site Vault.
projecthero.guide.loot.tier4: Tier 4 Dungeons: big multi-floor gauntlets with a mid-boss and a boss, 10-15 minutes each. A Dungeon Vault inside.
projecthero.guide.loot.sites.body: Every old site still does what it always did (its power, item or event is unchanged), but each now has an annex built beside it, facing the site: a hall in the site's style, a back room in its theme, and the vault room behind a locked Blast Door. The guard Captain at his desk carries the keycard (or clear an alarm wave to unlock it). An Alarm Panel stands in the hall and the guard on the porch is the Alarm Runner - drop him before he gets inside, or sabotage the panel. Cameras watch the porch and the hall (the old-world sites use a ward stone tripwire instead). Reach the Site Vault without the alarm going off for the Ghost bonus. The guards fit the site; they never despawn and do not burn in daylight. Site Vaults often hold a Hideout Locator. A 5-8 minute raid.
projecthero.guide.loot.site.dig_site: Dig Site: a timber field camp with a stash room. Syndicate looters; their Captain carries a shotgun.
projecthero.guide.loot.site.fallen_lante: Fallen Lantern Site: a green-glassed field station with an instrument room. Parademon scouts under a Parademon Captain.
projecthero.guide.loot.site.gamma_lab: Gamma Lab: a military barracks with an armoury. Soldiers under a sword-armed Captain.
projecthero.guide.loot.site.geological_s: Geological Site: a miners' camp with a stash room. Syndicate smugglers.
projecthero.guide.loot.site.government_s: Government Site: a guard barracks with an armoury. Government agents, a rifleman and an agent Captain.
projecthero.guide.loot.site.graveyard: Graveyard: a mausoleum with an ossuary behind a ward stone. Risen zombies and sword skeletons; an armoured zombie Captain.
projecthero.guide.loot.site.hydrostatic_: Hydrostatic Facility: a concrete pump house with a generator room. Syndicate scavengers.
projecthero.guide.loot.site.kryptonite_c: Kryptonite Crater: a government research station with an instrument room. Agents.
projecthero.guide.loot.site.meteor_impac: Meteor Impact: a field station with an instrument room. Parademons.
projecthero.guide.loot.site.mjolnir_crat: Mjolnir Crater: a Frost Giant ice hut with a cold store behind a ward stone. Jotun Raiders and Rime Hounds.
projecthero.guide.loot.site.nova_pod_sit: Nova Pod Site: a salvage station with an instrument room. Ultron drones under a Sentinel Captain.
projecthero.guide.loot.site.power_statio: Power Station: a plant room with a generator room. Ultron drones under a Sentinel Captain.
projecthero.guide.loot.site.research_fac: Research Facility: a white lab wing with a specimen room. Rogue Ultron drones.
projecthero.guide.loot.site.steel_crash_: Steel Crash Site: a field station with an instrument room. Ultron drones.
projecthero.guide.loot.site.symbiote_lab: Symbiote Lab: an overrun containment wing with a breached cell. Symbiote hosts under an infested vindicator Captain.
projecthero.guide.loot.site.symbiote_met: Symbiote Meteor: an overrun research post with a breached cell. Symbiote hosts.
projecthero.guide.loot.site.temple_of_kh: Temple of Khonshu: a sandstone shrine with an inner shrine behind a ward stone. Cultists and a Tomb Guardian Captain.
projecthero.guide.loot.site.tomb_of_nabu: Tomb of Nabu: a sandstone shrine with an inner shrine behind a ward stone. Cultists (on top of the tomb's own guardians).
projecthero.guide.loot.site.vigilante_sa: Vigilante Safehouse: a Syndicate shack with a stash room. Syndicate gunmen and a sniper.
projecthero.guide.structures.alarms: Guarded places (Tier 2 sites, villain hideouts and dungeons) run an alarm system: sneak past the guards or the whole place goes on alert. Every Tier 2 site's annex now has a Captain with the keycard to its vault room. See Loot & Progression.
